<div class="card-body">
'''Kal'Falnl C'ndros''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4017). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">カルファルニル・シンドロス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">カルのいるロケーションで戦闘が起こって、両方のプレイヤーが１枚ずつ戦闘運命数を求めた場合、自分の運命数が大きければ、相手の運命数は０になる。移動速度３。操縦する大型艦の戦力に＋２。脚が長すぎて、宇宙戦闘機や密閉型のビークルには乗れない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-kal-falnl-c-ndros-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">哺乳原類風の飛行種族、クオサヴのメス。身長３.５メートル。過保護な母親でフリーのパイロット。廊下の天井が高い専用宇宙船を所有する。卵生。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Kal'Falnl C'ndros.

'''Card text:''' When a battle occurs at Kal's location and each player draws one battle destiny, if your destiny is higher, your opponent's destiny becomes 0. Landspeed 3. Adds 2 to the power of a capital starship she pilots. Her legs are too long for her to board starfighters or enclosed vehicles.

'''Lore:''' A female Quor'sav, a flying species resembling primitive mammals. She is 3.5 meters tall, an overprotective mother, and a freelance pilot. She owns a personal starship with high-ceilinged corridors. She lays eggs.
